description: This file defines the internal class PeriodicAction, which provides a mechanism for executing an action periodically based on a specified time interval. It maintains the timing logic and determines when to invoke the action.

classes.name: PeriodicAction
classes.description: A class that encapsulates the logic for executing a specified action at regular time intervals.

methods.name: PeriodicAction
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the periodic action with a time span, the action to execute, and an optional start time.

methods.name: TryAction
methods.description: Attempts to execute the action if the current time has reached or passed the next scheduled execution time.
